jobs.occupation: Early Years Educator / Pädagogische Fachkraft Kindergarten englischsprachig (m/w/d) (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (m/w/d)
Full-time or part-time | Munich Alt-Bogenhausen

Phorms Campus Munich is a bilingual German-English education campus offering educational programmes from Crèche and Kindergarten through Primary School to Secondary School. Our well-located and lovingly maintained city campus in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, close to the English Garden, is home to an international school community where children, families and staff feel welcome, supported and valued.

In our bilingual Kindergarten and Crèche, we encourage children to try out new things, respect themselves and others, develop empathy and curiosity, and grow in confidence and independence. In this way, we build a strong foundation for their future education.

For our Kindergarten and Crèche in Munich Alt-Bogenhausen, we are looking for a motivated and qualified Early Years Educator / English-speaking Kindergarten Teacher (all genders) in full-time or part-time.

Your Responsibilities

• Supporting and fostering children in their individual development according to our Early Childhood curriculum
• Creating a warm, safe and stimulating learning environment for children in Crèche and Kindergarten
• Observing, assessing and documenting children’s learning journeys and developmental progress
• Planning and implementing age-appropriate educational activities
• Working closely with parents in a professional and trust-based parent-teacher partnership
• Bringing your own interests, strengths and creative ideas into the daily life of the Kindergarten
• Collaborating respectfully and supportively with colleagues in a bilingual and international team

Your Profile

• Completed qualification or degree in Early Childhood Education, Early Years Education, Childcare, Pedagogy, Social Pedagogy or a comparable field
• Ideally recognised as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria, or willingness to have your qualification checked for recognition
• Professional experience in early childhood education is an advantage
• Excellent English skills at native or near-native level, as you will work as an English-speaking reference person within our bilingual concept
• German language skills are not mandatory at the start
• Willingness and motivation to learn German and develop your language skills over time
• Enjoyment of working with children in Crèche and Kindergarten age groups
• Interest in working in a bilingual and international educational environment
• Team spirit, reliability, responsibility, empathy and motivation
• Valid work permit for Germany, EU citizenship or a residence title allowing employment in Germany

Our Benefits

• Attractive and competitive remuneration package                                                                                                   • Annual special payment of up to €1,500 gross, depending on working hours                                                    • Additional employer benefits, for example public transport pass or Edenred City Card
• Free healthy lunch
• Subsidised EGYM Wellpass membership
• Comprehensive company pension scheme
• Relocation support for work-related moves
• Corporate Benefits Portal
• 34 days of annual leave
• Regular working hours and long-term shift planning for better work-life balance
• Dedicated preparation and planning time, both individually and within the team
• Regular staff meetings during working hours
• Wide range of professional development and training opportunities
• Support in learning German through language courses and everyday practice in an international environment
• Attractively furnished group rooms, children’s kitchen, well-equipped gymnastics room, extensive library and generous outdoor area
• Modern digital equipment, including iPads and smart displays in preschool
• Bilingual teaching teams with up to three qualified pedagogical team members per group
• Support from additional teaching and administrative staff, including music and sports teachers
• Age-oriented groups with dedicated preschool classes
• A warm, international team on a beautiful campus close to the English Garden

Please note

For this position, a relevant early years qualification is required. Applications from international professionals are welcome, provided that a valid work permit for Germany is in place or can be obtained. For qualifications obtained outside Germany, recognition as a qualified early years professional in Bavaria should already be available or be possible to assess.

German language skills are not required at the beginning. However, we are looking for candidates who are motivated to learn German and willing to develop their language skills while working in our international environment.

Would you like to support children in a bilingual, international Kindergarten and bring your English language skills into meaningful early years education? Then we look forward to receiving your application via our website.

Further information can be found at: https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/ (https://www.phorms.de/en/career/munich/) .
If you have any questions, please contact Katharina: careers@phorms.de (https://mailto:careers@phorms.de)

jobs.occupation: Manager Internal Communications (f/m/d) (Kommunikationsassistent/in)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

Effective communication turns strategy into action. In this role, you shape how complex topics are understood across the organization and enable alignment at all levels. You will work closely with senior leadership and have a direct impact on transparency, engagement, and successful transformation.

Do you enjoy bringing clarity to complex topics and aligning different stakeholders? Do you want to work closely with senior leaders and make communication a real driver of business success? And are you motivated to build structures that enable effective communication across an organization?

- Strategy & Governance: Develop and implement a company-wide internal communication framework, including formats, editorial planning, and clear responsibilities to ensure consistent and effective communication.
- Executive Communication: Partner with senior leadership to shape key messages and ensure consistency across channels such as all-hands meetings, written updates, and ad-hoc communications.
- Leadership Enablement: Support managers in communicating key topics within their teams, making complex messages understandable and actionable in day-to-day business.
- Change Communication: Provide structure and narrative for transformation initiatives, translating complex developments into clear, engaging communication that creates alignment.
- Dialogue & Feedback: Establish formats that enable open exchange, capture employee sentiment, and ensure feedback is reflected in decision-making processes.

Your Profile

Have you worked in roles where communication was critical to the success of complex initiatives? Are you experienced in aligning stakeholders with different perspectives and driving clarity in dynamic environments? And are you ready to take the next step into a role with company-wide communication impact?

- Background & Experience: Degree in communications, business, social sciences, media, or a related field, or equivalent qualification. Experience in roles where communication is a key success factor (e.g., project, transformation, program, stakeholder management, consulting, or cross-functional roles).
- Stakeholder & Complexity Management: Proven ability to work in complex environments with diverse stakeholders, ensuring alignment through structured communication and continuous dialogue.
- Communication Skills: Strong ability to structure, simplify, and convey complex topics for different target audiences across various formats and channels.
- Advisory & Influencing Skills: Experience working with senior stakeholders, providing guidance, challenging perspectives constructively, and driving communication effectiveness.
- Language & Mindset: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English, combined with a proactive, structured, and impact-oriented working style.

🏢 Lived corporate culture: Flat hierarchies, a culture of respect and appreciation, signatories of the Diversity Charter, open communication and no dress code

🚝 Mobility: Subsidy for job bike leasing and the job ticket

💻 Flexible working models: Home office options, flexible working hours and 30 days of vacation with the option for additional unpaid leave

💰 Financial benefits: Corporate benefits, company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits, occupational disability insurance and various partner discounts

🎉 Events: Summer and winter parties, sports tournaments and team events

jobs.occupation: Expert Project Planning & Scheduling (m/f/d) (Projektingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

The first 8 weeks of any given project are considered the most critical and crucial for the initialization of the project and the successful execution of the same. To help the BUs and the RAs organizations, it has been decided to create a new group that will be mainly focused on executing the project setup, ensuring the needed infrastructures, software, systems, procedures and tools are correctly implemented to guarantee a consistent and structured project delivery approach, in line with contractual requirements and Client's expectations.
The Expert Project Planning & Scheduling (m/f/d) is expected to initiate the project planning and contribute to its successful execution. This includes preparing, monitoring, and ensuring compliance with all planning and scheduling requirements to meet client expectations and contractual obligations.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Prepare project planning and scheduling tools and track the delivery of key inputs.
- Implement all tools in accordance with corporate requirements (mandatory tools) and ensure a corporate-compliant planning and scheduling setup, including the project master schedule and the progress measurement system.
- Align planning and scheduling systems with the company's information requirements (e.g., SAP).
- Develop all necessary documentation and procedures for the implementation of the aforementioned tools and systems.
- Ensure that the planning systems are set up according to the standardized WBS structure and are configured to exchange data with oneERP.

Show your expertise

- Master's degree in Engineering, Economics, or Project Management, coupled with several years of relevant operational experience in the construction industry.
- Demonstrated in-depth knowledge of project planning and the proven ability to analyze technical documents effectively.
- Skilled in introducing new methodologies and techniques in planning, with a strong track record of working collaboratively with internal teams and external consultants.
- Proven experience in ensuring all planning systems align with company information requirements like SAP and are set up according to standardized WBS structures, enhancing data exchange with systems such as oneERP.
- Fluent in English with German being a significant plus. You also exhibit strong verbal and written communication skills and proactive behavior, essential for successful team and client interactions.

What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through eGym Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact:

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

A home where people learn and thrive

jobs.occupation: English-speaking Primary School Teacher (Lehrer/in - Grundschulen)
jobs.description:
For the International Montessori School **in Berlin-Wannsee **we are looking for an

English-Speaking Primary School Teacher

Ref. Nr. 376DR-BA

Your Employer

Montessori & Friends Education gGmbH is an innovative educational institution that runs several children’s centres, the International Bilingual Montessori Primary School and its own Montessori Academy. These facilities create nurturing learning environments for children based on the educational philosophy of Maria Montessori. At the primary school, 130 children learn in mixed-age groups on the grade-levels 1-6. The historic school building is situated in an idyllic location not far from Lake Wannsee. The opening of a secondary school on the same site is planned for the 2026/27 academic year. The school’s aim is to promote self-directed learning and support the holistic development of the children. Another key focus of the school is bilingual education. Around half of the pupils come from English-speaking or bilingual homes and are taught bilingually from grade 1 in both German and English.

Your Responsibilities

As a teacher, you will guide a maximum of 24 students in mixed-age learning groups (grades 1–3) and provide them with individualized support. You will be actively supported by a co-teacher. You will teach all standard elementary school subjects exclusively in English and work according to the principles of Montessori pedagogy. A trusting partnership with parents is just as important as your own creative freedom.

The school offers you 

- a permanent, full-time position,
- competitive compensation, as well as additional benefits and bonuses,
- Childcare spots for your own children in the school’s own daycare centers and at the school, subject to availability,
- regular professional development opportunities and a chance to gain an internationally recognized Montessori-Diploma,
- a supportive team and a friendly, family-like work environment.

This opportunity is for you if

- you have a teaching qualification recognised in the Federal State of Berlin, such as a Master of Education, a German 2. Staatsexamen für die Grundschule/Sekundarstufe I, a foreign teaching degree, or (N)QTS.
- you have already gained experience teaching English at the primary school level,
- you have a Montessori diploma or practical Montessori experience, and the willingness to earn a Montessori diploma while working at the school,
- you have a minimum of a C1 level in English and a minimum of a B1 level in German,
- you enjoy working in a team and cooperating closely with parents and caregivers.

Have we piqued your interest?

If so, we look forward to receiving your application, including your CV and details of your relevant qualifications. Please send your application, quoting reference number 376DR-BA, via email (info@lehrcare.de) in PDF format, to Dorottya Toth, who will be happy to provide you with further information.
